model_identity: Luna as requested; exact model build identifier unavailable

type_definitions.image-frame: One selected raster image or video frame with source index and image-space coordinates.
type_definitions.joint-set: Explicit joint records with parent/child links, type, origin, axis, limits, units and source status.
type_definitions.collision-set: One or more primitive colliders or convex pieces with frame, source hash and approximation recipe.
type_definitions.material-set: Material properties or densities with units, source and evidence status.
type_definitions.mass-properties: Mass, center of mass and inertia tensor with units, frame and measured/claimed/calculated/assumed status.
type_definitions.component-record: Versioned component identity, source/license records, geometry assets, units, frames, interfaces and physical properties.
type_definitions.assembly-graph: Named parts/instances, parent relations, transforms, connection features and explicit joint records.
type_definitions.reconstruction-scene: Camera solution and one or more point, mesh, Gaussian or NeRF representations linked to capture inputs.
type_definitions.control-network: Measured image/model/world points and known lengths used for calibration, registration or scale, each with uncertainty and frame.
type_definitions.b-rep: Boundary-representation solid or surface model with exact/spline faces and topological edges/vertices.
type_definitions.fabrication-package: Native CAD, drawings, neutral solids, material/process notes and revision-linked manufacturing metadata.
type_definitions.source-library: A library record or dataset pointer with original URL, per-asset licence/terms, version/revision and retrieval metadata.
type_definitions.text: Original written description or requirement text, with source identity and revision.
type_definitions.dimensions: Dimension values with units, datum/frame, source and status.
type_definitions.measurement-set: Measurements with units, coordinate frame, method, source and uncertainty/status.
type_definitions.raster-sketch: Raster image of a sketch, indexed by source file and pixel frame.
type_definitions.raster-plan: Raster floor/site plan with source scale and image frame.
type_definitions.vector-drawing: Vector drawing such as DXF/SVG with layer/entity identity, source units and frame.
type_definitions.cad-solid: A CAD solid model with unit, frame and source lineage.
type_definitions.cad-assembly: A CAD assembly containing named parts/instances and placements; articulation intent may be a separate joint-set.
type_definitions.parametric-source: Editable CAD feature history or source script with named parameters.
type_definitions.ifc: IFC building information model with entities, relationships, units and placements.
type_definitions.mesh: Polygon mesh with units/frame, source hash and topology/quality metadata.
type_definitions.point-cloud: Point coordinates with units/frame, registration and capture provenance.
type_definitions.photo-set: Source still images with capture order, camera metadata where available, and licensing/provenance.
type_definitions.depth-frames: Depth images or depth-camera frames with intrinsics, scale, timestamps and source frame.
type_definitions.camera-solution: Camera poses/intrinsics and reconstruction scale, with controls and estimated uncertainty.
type_definitions.model-brief: Normalized requirements and design intent with measurement/value provenance.
type_definitions.constrained-sketch: Editable 2D profile with constraints/dimensions and source links.
type_definitions.robot-assembly: Named robot links and their CAD geometry/placement with kinematic relation references.
type_definitions.mjcf: MuJoCo XML model plus referenced assets, units convention, frames and model version.
type_definitions.urdf: URDF robot description and referenced assets, units convention and package manifest.
type_definitions.visual-scene: Presentation scene or geometry package with object identities and placements.
type_definitions.step-file: Neutral STEP exchange file with schema, source identity, units, assembly structure status and importer/exporter provenance.
type_definitions.native-model-document: Editable application-native CAD document with source identity, units, frames and revision; may contain direct geometry without feature history.
type_definitions.registration-transform: Rigid or similarity transform from named source frame to target frame, with method, control set, residuals and units/axis convention.
type_definitions.physical-measurement-set: Measured or source-reported mass, center of mass and/or inertia records with units, method, source, uncertainty/status and measurement frame; dimensions alone do not satisfy this type.

operations.name: Normalize model brief
tools: existing OCS engineering skill; structured project schema proposal
prerequisites: Input sources retained with identity and access terms.
preserves: Original wording, measurements, source units, source frame and evidence status.
changes_or_infers: Normalize names and units; separate measured values, source claims, assumptions and calculated values.
checks: Every required parameter has value/status/unit/source or a recorded ambiguity.
alternatives: Manual brief review; schema-driven intake form.
operations.summary: Create a source-linked requirements record before geometry operations.

operations.name: Raster sketch to constrained sketch
tools: OpenCADStudio; FreeCAD Sketcher; manual image tracing
prerequisites: Known scale or one or more dimension controls; sketch plane/orientation identified.
preserves: Raster source, pixel coordinates, interpreted scale and dimension-to-pixel references.
changes_or_infers: Pixels become line/arc geometry; undimensioned lengths remain image estimates.
checks: Dimensions trace to source; closure/constraint state; view consistency; scale residual on independent controls.
alternatives: Vectorization for clean line art; manual constrained sketch for engineering drawings.
operations.summary: Turn a calibrated sketch image into constrained 2D geometry while retaining pixel evidence.

operations.name: DXF/SVG drawing to constrained profile
tools: OpenCADStudio; FreeCAD Sketcher; CadQuery DXF import; OpenSCAD DXF linear_extrude
prerequisites: Source units, layers/blocks, target sketch plane and intended entities identified.
preserves: Source drawing, entity/layer IDs and original coordinates.
changes_or_infers: Select/clean curves, convert units if needed, close profiles and apply constraints.
checks: Open/closed profiles, self-intersections, holes, bounds/area and source dimension comparisons.
alternatives: OCS-native DXF editing; FreeCAD sketch import; CadQuery DXF profile route.
operations.summary: Create editable profiles from vector drawing entities with explicit filtering and unit handling.

operations.name: Brief/profile to native CAD solid
tools: OpenCADStudio baseline; FreeCAD; CadQuery; build123d; OpenSCAD
prerequisites: Dimensions, datums, units and component boundaries resolved; backend supports required solid features.
preserves: Input geometry evidence, editable native document or script and parameter names.
changes_or_infers: Construct features/booleans; any assumed design values remain labeled as assumptions.
checks: Solid validity, feature/part counts, analytic surfaces, controlling dimensions, saved-file reopen.
alternatives: Interactive OCS/FreeCAD; code-parametric CadQuery/build123d; OpenSCAD CSG source.
operations.summary: Author a CAD solid and save the editable native document. OCS documents/solids need not contain procedural feature history; use DOM-40 for script-based parametric source.

operations.name: Export STEP solid
tools: OCS STEP exporter; FreeCAD/Open CASCADE STEP import/export
prerequisites: Source/target frame and units declared; recipient supports the chosen STEP schema.
preserves: Source native file, part identifiers and original STEP bytes.
changes_or_infers: Exporter may tessellate or flatten feature history; OCS inspected writer emits planar faces from triangles.
checks: Reopen in independent consumer; compare solids, bounds, volume, holes and analytic surface types.
alternatives: Native document for feature history; STEP for geometry exchange; STL/OBJ for mesh-only exchange.
operations.summary: Export a CAD solid or B-rep to a neutral STEP file; feature history and exactness depend on the source exporter.

operations.name: Library asset intake and rights record
tools: component registry/schema proposal; source license review
prerequisites: Original source identity and item-level license/terms available or explicitly unknown.
preserves: Original file, URL, retrieved date, hash, attribution, license text/terms and source claims.
changes_or_infers: Normalize metadata; derived conversions become separate assets with lineage.
checks: License status per file; duplicate hash; units/frame; source part number and revision when stated.
alternatives: Keep external link only where local caching/redistribution terms are unclear.
operations.summary: Create immutable, rights-aware component records instead of treating catalogs as a common license.

operations.name: Place reusable component in assembly
tools: OCS; FreeCAD Assembly Workbench; native CAD assembly API
prerequisites: Component has named interface frames or measured mounting datums; target assembly frame known.
preserves: Component revision/hash, source frame and local geometry.
changes_or_infers: Adds occurrence transform and assembly connection relations.
checks: Interface transform consistency; interference; component identities and revision pins.
alternatives: Manual datum placement; constraint-driven assembly solver.
operations.summary: Reuse a component by transforming its named interfaces rather than editing source geometry.

operations.name: CAD assembly to articulated robot structure
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench; explicit robot-description authoring; CAD-to-URDF scripts as candidates
prerequisites: Rigid link groups, parent-child relation, joint type, axis/frame/limits and fixed connections are explicit or reviewed.
preserves: CAD part IDs, geometry, named joint frames, source measurements and assembly transforms.
changes_or_infers: Groups occurrences into links; assembly constraints are mapped to robot joints; inferred joint types remain hypotheses.
checks: Graph connectivity, tree/loop identification, frame transforms, axis signs and limit source.
alternatives: Author URDF joint records directly; export FreeCAD Assembly4 through community script; inspect CAD_TO_URDF inferred tree.
operations.summary: Translate a mechanical assembly into explicit link and joint semantics; CAD hierarchy alone is insufficient.

operations.name: Robot assembly to URDF package
tools: URDF XML/Xacro authoring; ROS urdf_tutorial; CAD-to-URDF adapter proposal
prerequisites: Robot link/joint tree defined; mesh units and origins known; mass/inertia records have source and frame.
preserves: Part IDs, joint axes, limits, mesh lineage, mass/inertia provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD links become URDF links; supported tree joints are mapped; CAD history/material layers may be omitted.
checks: Parse URDF; graph tree; positive mass and valid inertia; FK transforms; mesh path resolution and RViz/model consumer load.
alternatives: URDF for ROS ecosystem; direct MJCF for simulator-rich model.
operations.summary: Export a reviewed robot assembly into ROS link/joint XML and mesh assets.

operations.name: URDF import and MJCF conversion
tools: MuJoCo URDF parser/compiler; mjSpec API
prerequisites: URDF files and referenced meshes resolve; mass/inertia and units are coherent.
preserves: Original URDF; input meshes; declared mapping and MuJoCo version.
changes_or_infers: URDF subset compiles into MJCF/mjSpec; actuator model absent in URDF; unsupported features require authoring.
checks: Load/compile; compare joint count/limits/axes and FK; inspect dropped or defaulted fields; validate XML extensions separately.
alternatives: Author MJCF directly; retain URDF plus MJCF extension if ROS remains source consumer.
operations.summary: Use MuJoCo's URDF parser as a conversion bridge and record its subset/losses.

operations.name: Author native MJCF simulation model
tools: MuJoCo MJCF XML and mjSpec API
prerequisites: Consistent units chosen; body tree and element frames explicit; contact/actuation scope defined.
preserves: Editable XML/spec, mesh assets, frame definitions, physical-property provenance.
changes_or_infers: CAD components become bodies/geoms; density-based inertial calculation only where explicitly intended.
checks: MJCF schema/parser compile; inertia validity; joints, contact pairs, solver/actuator parameters and asset paths.
alternatives: URDF import as a starting point; MuJoCo Menagerie as licensed model/reference.
operations.summary: Maintain a native MuJoCo XML/spec model with explicit simulation-only information.

operations.name: Export mesh assets for MuJoCo
tools: CAD mesh exporter; Blender; Open CASCADE tessellation
prerequisites: Tessellation settings and mesh local frame/units chosen.
preserves: Source CAD/B-rep and conversion parameters.
changes_or_infers: Surface geometry becomes triangles; MuJoCo supports OBJ and binary STL; material assignment is separate.
checks: Bounds, scale, normals, topology, source/mesh overlay and referenced geom role.
alternatives: MuJoCo primitives for simple geometry; custom decoder plugin for other asset formats.
operations.summary: Create simulation mesh files and retain their source frame and approximation settings.

operations.name: Generate convex collision set
tools: CoACD; V-HACD; primitive fitting
prerequisites: Input mesh local frame and scale known; collision features/contact regions identified.
preserves: Input visual mesh, source hash, license, decomposition parameters and derived hull set.
changes_or_infers: Nonconvex surface approximated by convex pieces; holes/passages may be filled or altered.
checks: Hull finite bounds; compare envelope/volume; inspect missing passages; simulator contact fixtures.
alternatives: Primitive colliders; single convex hull for coarse bounding; use original mesh only where supported and semantics understood.
operations.summary: Derive a collision-specific approximation and review topology-sensitive errors.

operations.name: Calculate or import physical mass properties
tools: CAD kernel mass properties; MuJoCo compiler geom inference; measured scale
prerequisites: Geometry scale/frame and density or measured mass stated; inertia reference frame defined.
preserves: Raw input values, source evidence, units and chosen frame.
changes_or_infers: Computes volume/COM/inertia from B-rep or mesh and density, or assigns measured values.
checks: Mass positive; tensor symmetric/positive-definite and triangle inequalities; compare independent mass where available; confirm mesh watertightness.
alternatives: Measured mass and center of gravity; manufacturer data; calculated mass with explicit density assumption.
operations.summary: Attach physical properties to the exact geometry revision and label calculation assumptions.

operations.name: Author semantic IFC building
tools: Bonsai; IfcOpenShell API
prerequisites: Storey/frame, element classes, openings, spatial relations and property requirements declared.
preserves: Element IDs, semantic relationships, object placements, source dimensions, property values and geometry representation type.
changes_or_infers: Creates IfcProduct relationships and representations; parametric profiles or mesh representations are distinct IFC options.
checks: Schema validation, unique GlobalIds, placement, property-set and relationship checks, IDS requirements.
alternatives: Bonsai authoring UI; scripted IfcOpenShell creation; IFC import followed by semantic enrichment.
operations.summary: Create building elements and semantics with explicit parametric or mesh geometry representation.

operations.name: Extract IFC geometry as triangles
tools: IfcOpenShell geom.create_shape/iterator; IfcConvert
prerequisites: IFC schema and length units read; target representation chosen.
preserves: IFC source, GlobalId/entity map, item/material IDs and object placement.
changes_or_infers: Geometry API can emit tessellated triangles or OpenCASCADE B-rep; extraction is a derived geometry view.
checks: Element ID mapping, bounds, face/solid count, volume and units against source; relationships remain in IFC.
alternatives: Triangulation for display/clash; B-rep where analytic editing/surface inspection is required.
operations.summary: Extract IFC geometry as tessellated triangles and retain its element mapping.

operations.name: IFC to GLB display scene
tools: IfcOpenShell IfcConvert; Blender; GLB export
prerequisites: Element-to-display mapping and length/orientation conversion are declared.
preserves: IFC source/hash; stable element IDs; source properties in sidecar mapping where GLB cannot retain them.
changes_or_infers: BIM objects become render nodes/meshes; semantic/relationship data may be reduced or remapped.
checks: ID-to-node coverage, bounds, orientation, selected geometry hashes or residuals, output hashes.
alternatives: Use IFC-native viewer when BIM relationships/properties are the primary task.
operations.summary: Create a visual GLB derivative with provenance and object mapping, not a replacement IFC.

operations.name: Raster floor plan to IFC building
tools: Image calibration; OCS/FreeCAD sketching; Bonsai/IfcOpenShell
prerequisites: Known plan scale/control lengths, orientation, floor elevation and interpretation rules for walls/openings.
preserves: Original raster, scale transform, interpreted linework, dimension sources and uncertain regions.
changes_or_infers: Pixels interpreted as boundaries and building elements; semantic classification is human/model inference.
checks: Wall thickness, openings, elevations, spatial containment, area/element checks and IFC validation.
alternatives: Vector drawing to sketch if original CAD exists; manual IFC authoring for high-confidence boundaries.
operations.summary: Build semantic IFC from a raster plan, normalized building brief, dimensions, measured controls and licensed component sources; document scale, axes, elevations and interpretation decisions.

operations.name: Register scan to building frame
tools: COLMAP/AliceVision; Open3D/CloudCompare; IFC geometry as reference
prerequisites: At least one common frame datum and distributed control points/lengths; scan sensor calibration available.
preserves: Raw images/depth, capture settings, raw reconstruction and all transforms.
changes_or_infers: Aligns the scan to IFC coordinates; registration adjusts pose/scale, not building semantics.
checks: Registration residuals and held-out distances; check local regions separately and flag occlusion.
alternatives: Surveyed control transformation; ICP refinement after coarse frame alignment.
operations.summary: Register the scan point cloud to the IFC/building frame using measured controls; output the transform and aligned point cloud. Camera poses are not created unless camera observations are supplied.

operations.name: Photos/video to camera solution, point cloud and mesh
tools: COLMAP/pycolmap; AliceVision/Meshroom; OpenMVG/OpenMVS
prerequisites: Overlapping sharp views, camera metadata/calibration where available, scene motion/lighting assessed and scale controls identified.
preserves: Original frames, camera solution, control points, reconstruction settings, sparse/dense outputs.
changes_or_infers: Videos sampled into images; camera poses and dense surfaces are estimated from image correspondences.
checks: Registered-view coverage, reprojection residuals, independent scale distances, surface holes and withheld checks.
alternatives: RGB-D/LiDAR for metric depth; single-image learned mesh only for visual proposal.
operations.summary: Reconstruct visible geometry and camera poses from image sequences; monocular scale requires external controls.

operations.name: Depth frames to registered point cloud or mesh
tools: Open3D; CloudCompare
prerequisites: Sensor model, calibration, units, extrinsics and depth validity/range known.
preserves: Raw depth/color, frame timestamps, sensor coordinates and transforms.
changes_or_infers: Registration, filtering and surface fusion combine depth samples into new geometry.
checks: Loop closure, registration residual, independent lengths, depth noise and coverage.
alternatives: Photogrammetry for passive optical scenes; per-frame point cloud where fusion is inappropriate.
operations.summary: Fuse calibrated depth observations into metric geometry while retaining the raw sensor frames.

operations.name: Photographs to Gaussian/NeRF visual scene
tools: Nerfstudio/gsplat; COLMAP camera input; Blender viewer/export
prerequisites: Camera poses and training configuration available; GPU/runtime/weight license assessed for selected implementation.
preserves: Original images, camera poses, training settings, checkpoints and output license provenance.
changes_or_infers: Learns view-dependent appearance; extracted depth/mesh is a further inferred derivative.
checks: Held-out viewpoints, appearance consistency, depth/geometry consistency and scale status.
alternatives: COLMAP/MVS mesh for surface-oriented output; Blender scene reconstruction for manually authored context.
operations.summary: Build a navigable visual reconstruction and keep it separate from dimensional CAD evidence.

operations.name: Scan or mesh to parametric CAD remodeling
tools: Open3D/CloudCompare measurement; OCS baseline; FreeCAD/OCCT solid modeling
prerequisites: Source scan frame/scale calibrated; independent interface dimensions and target function stated.
preserves: Source point cloud/mesh, control measurements, fits, residual map and authored feature dimensions.
changes_or_infers: Selected observed regions are approximated by constrained planes/cylinders/features; hidden geometry is a proposal unless measured.
checks: Held-out scan-to-CAD distances; functional interfaces; solid validity and saved-file reopen.
alternatives: Retain mesh when only appearance/clearance context is needed; direct reverse-engineered surface B-rep if warranted.
operations.summary: Convert observed geometry into editable CAD features without promoting inferred regions to measured facts.

operations.name: Assemble and inspect Blender scene
tools: Blender Python API; Blender MCP; background Blender scripts
prerequisites: Input adapters resolve; transform, units, geometry role and licenses recorded.
preserves: Source files, object/component IDs, import mapping, unit and axis transforms.
changes_or_infers: Builds a render scene, materials/cameras, mesh derivatives; scene-only outputs can drop CAD/BIM/robot semantics.
checks: Transform/numeric bounds, linked asset paths, representative camera views, exported GLB reopen and object mapping.
alternatives: Direct scripted background processing for repeatability; MCP for iterative live inspection; OCS remains engineering baseline.
operations.summary: Use Blender for visual composition, mesh work and inspection while retaining native domain models; a camera-solution input alone can produce a camera-only scene.

operations.name: Create fabrication package
tools: Native CAD drawing/workbench; STEP/DXF/PDF exporters
prerequisites: Design revision, manufacturing process, required dimensions/tolerances and materials sourced.
preserves: Native source, dimensions, drawing references, part IDs and export settings.
changes_or_infers: Creates manufacturing views, annotations and derived exports; exports may omit feature history and tolerances.
checks: Dimension source trace, drawing/model revision agreement, units, holes/bounds, recipient reopen.
alternatives: 2D DXF profile package for flat parts; STEP plus drawing for machined geometry.
operations.summary: Produce drawings and exchange geometry tied to one authoritative model revision.

operations.name: Version and reuse component revision
tools: content-addressed files; Git metadata; source/license registry
prerequisites: Stable component ID, exact source bytes, item terms and conversion lineage recorded.
preserves: Existing revisions and assemblies pinning them; original files are immutable.
changes_or_infers: New source content or license produces a new revision/digest; derived files link to input/tool versions.
checks: Hash consistency, dependency/license closure, revision pinning and reproducible export manifests.
alternatives: Git for small source assets; LFS/content-addressed storage for large licensed assets after policy check.
operations.summary: Keep reusable assets immutable and project assemblies reproducible against pinned revisions.

operations.name: Extract IFC geometry as OpenCASCADE B-rep
tools: IfcOpenShell geom.create_shape/iterator using OpenCASCADE kernel
prerequisites: IFC schema and length units read; target elements have geometry interpretable by selected kernel.
preserves: IFC source, element GlobalIds, placements and mapping metadata.
changes_or_infers: Extracts a kernel B-rep as a derived shape; IFC semantics remain in source IFC.
checks: B-rep validity, face types, bounds, volume and entity-ID mapping.
alternatives: DOM-16 tessellated extraction for display or mesh consumers.
operations.summary: Extract analytic/spline boundary representations from IFC where the kernel supports them.

operations.name: Dense multi-view stereo to point cloud and mesh
tools: COLMAP dense reconstruction; AliceVision/Meshroom; OpenMVS
prerequisites: Camera solution and image set correspond; scale/control transform is available for metric results.
preserves: Sparse camera solution, source images, dense settings and intermediate depth maps where available.
changes_or_infers: Estimates visible depth/surfaces and fuses points; mesh topology and texture are derived.
checks: Coverage, holes, reprojection, independent dimensions and surface residuals.
alternatives: Depth sensor integration via DOM-21; visual scene via DOM-22/30.
operations.summary: Compute dense surfaces from a previously estimated camera solution.

operations.name: Point cloud to surface mesh
tools: Open3D surface reconstruction; CloudCompare mesh reconstruction; Blender mesh cleanup
prerequisites: Point cloud has known frame, scale, normals if required, and density/noise characteristics.
preserves: Input cloud, processing parameters, local frame and mesh lineage.
changes_or_infers: Interpolates surfaces between samples; fills and smooths gaps depending on method.
checks: Surface deviation to source cloud, holes, components, normals and over-smoothed features.
alternatives: Keep point cloud if no surface fill is justified; direct CAD remodeling via DOM-23.
operations.summary: Create a mesh surface from point samples and retain the interpolation as an inferred derivative.

operations.name: Photos to NeRF visual scene
tools: Nerfstudio; COLMAP camera input
prerequisites: Camera poses, training parameters, model/checkpoint license and runtime requirements are recorded.
preserves: Source images, poses, configuration, checkpoints and export lineage.
changes_or_infers: Learns view-dependent scene appearance; extracted geometry is an additional inferred derivative.
checks: Held-out view appearance, camera consistency and separate depth/mesh geometry checks.
alternatives: DOM-22 Gaussian scene; DOM-28 photogrammetric surface reconstruction.
operations.summary: Train a NeRF-style visual scene while preserving capture and model provenance.

operations.name: Author assembly graph and joint set
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
prerequisites: Assembly part identities and placements exist; brief states intended motion or records unresolved motion questions.
preserves: Source CAD geometry and measured interface records.
changes_or_infers: Creates explicit graph and joint records; interpretation of motion intent remains reviewable.
checks: Each movable relation has parent/child, type, origin, axis, limits/units and source; graph topology is reported as tree or loop.
alternatives: For a documented existing assembly/joint mapping, use the relevant source app/exporter adapter.
operations.summary: Explicitly author parent-child links, joint types, origins, axes and limits from assembly geometry, measured interfaces and stated motion intent; software does not infer engineering intent.

operations.name: Map CAD link geometry to MJCF body tree
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
prerequisites: Selected MJCF model and per-asset rights record are identified; CAD part-to-body map and frame transforms are reviewed.
preserves: MJCF joint topology, actuator/sensor declarations and model source revision.
changes_or_infers: Adds/replaces geometry and may alter visual appearance or collision representation.
checks: All mapped parts resolve; compare body transforms and bounds; compile model; inspect visual and collision roles separately.
alternatives: Rebuild the MJCF body tree directly when the selected seed model cannot accept a geometry mapping.
operations.summary: Map a rights-recorded CAD component to existing MJCF bodies and replace/add geometry while preserving declared body/joint topology; require explicit part-to-body mapping.

operations.name: Add environment collision geometry to MJCF
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
prerequisites: Source MJCF/environment frames are named; collision-set approximation and transform are recorded.
preserves: Robot body/joint graph and source scan/mesh.
changes_or_infers: Adds static environment geoms and collision pieces.
checks: Compile model; compare environment bounds and transforms; inspect passage openings and contact fixtures.
alternatives: Use primitives, analytic shapes or simulator-native geoms when the environment does not need mesh colliders.
operations.summary: Add registered environment geometry and colliders to an existing MJCF scene, preserving scene frame and explicit collision approximation.

operations.name: Author static MuJoCo environment from BIM mesh
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
prerequisites: Environment mesh and collision pieces share a known frame/scale; source IFC IDs are mapped.
preserves: IFC source project and element IDs.
changes_or_infers: Creates static MuJoCo geom assets from IFC-derived derivatives.
checks: Compile model; compare element coverage, bounds, transforms and collision simplification.
alternatives: Author a static MJCF environment directly from primitives or other verified mesh sources.
operations.summary: Create a static MuJoCo world from IFC-derived display mesh and collision representation; this operation does not author a robot.

operations.name: Place library component in semantic IFC
tools: documented adapter or explicit authoring step
prerequisites: Component record identifies exact geometry bytes, per-asset terms and placement interfaces; IFC project units and target frame known.
preserves: Existing IFC entity identities, component source provenance and original component bytes.
changes_or_infers: Adds a placed instance and semantic class/properties supported by the selected IFC authoring adapter.
checks: IFC validation; placement and classification; source component mapping and stable identity; rights record attached.
alternatives: Author the IFC component instance directly with IfcOpenShell API or another IFC-authoring application.
operations.summary: Place a licensed component instance in an IFC project with source identity, placement and semantic classification retained where representable.

operations.name: Author robot assembly from CAD component
tools: FreeCAD Assembly Workbench or explicit CAD assembly authoring
prerequisites: The brief states the component role, parent link, motion intent, axis and limits or records an ambiguity.
preserves: Source STEP/CAD identity, component placement evidence and units.
changes_or_infers: Authors assembly occurrence, frame and joint records from explicit requirements and measurements.
checks: Assembly placement and interfaces match measured controls; joint type/axis/limits are reviewed before export.
alternatives: For an existing assembly, use DOM-08 with authored joint-set.
operations.summary: Create a robot assembly occurrence and explicit joints from the sourced CAD component, stated role and measured interfaces; no joint type is inferred from mesh shape.

operations.name: Import STEP solid into CAD representation
operations.summary: Import a supplied neutral STEP file to the project CAD representation; a faceted STEP source remains faceted after import. **Exact adapter fidelity depends on importer.**
tools: FreeCAD/Open CASCADE STEP adapter
prerequisites: Source schema, units and assembly structure are inspected before import/export.
preserves: Original STEP bytes and provenance; imported product identity and placement where available.
changes_or_infers: Import creates a CAD representation; export creates a neutral exchange file that may lose native history.
checks: Reopen in independent consumer; compare bounds/volume/part count and known interfaces.
alternatives: Use the receiving CAD application’s native STEP importer and preserve the source STEP file.

operations.name: Export STEP assembly
operations.summary: Export named CAD assembly instances and placements to STEP exchange where the selected exporter preserves assembly structure; verify the exported part tree.
tools: FreeCAD/Open CASCADE STEP adapter
prerequisites: Source schema, units and assembly structure are inspected before import/export.
preserves: Original STEP bytes and provenance; imported product identity and placement where available.
changes_or_infers: Import creates a CAD representation; export creates a neutral exchange file that may lose native history.
checks: Reopen in independent consumer; compare bounds/volume/part count and known interfaces.
alternatives: Export individual solids separately when the target consumer cannot preserve assembly structure.

operations.name: Script-parametric CAD authoring
tools: CadQuery; build123d; OpenSCAD; FreeCAD Python
prerequisites: Parameters, units, datum and solid design intent are explicit.
preserves: Executable source, package/version, parameter names and input provenance.
changes_or_infers: Script defines feature/CSG operations; generated B-rep may differ by kernel/version.
checks: Run source in declared environment; validate solid topology and controlling dimensions; compare saved export and source.
alternatives: Use DOM-04 application-native solid authoring when feature/script history is not required.
operations.summary: Generate a CAD solid from a reviewed, editable parametric script; code source is retained as a separate product.

recipes.name: Raster plan and site survey to registered IFC
recipes.goal: Create a semantic IFC building from a plan and brief; register photo/depth evidence to its frame; derive display geometry.
handoffs: Normalized brief and plan create one semantic IFC; photo/depth capture yields camera/point-cloud evidence; scan-to-IFC registration returns transform and aligned cloud with control residuals. Camera poses are separate outputs of photogrammetry, not scan registration.
recipes.summary: Plan and written brief create IFC; image/depth capture yields camera and point-cloud evidence; registration and geometry extraction produce inspected derivatives.

recipes.name: Manufacturer STEP component to robot link
recipes.goal: Create a sourced component record and a robot link representation with explicit interfaces, joint intent and mass properties.
handoffs: The supplied neutral STEP file is the actual seed; import fidelity is checked. DOM-37 explicitly authors an assembly occurrence and joints from model brief and measured interfaces; software does not infer engineering intent.
recipes.summary: Intake records the file and terms; explicit assembly/joint authoring defines its robot role; physical properties, collision, and URDF package are separate checked products.

recipes.name: CAD robot assembly to URDF then MJCF
recipes.goal: Produce a robot assembly representation, URDF package and MuJoCo MJCF derivative.
handoffs: The CAD assembly and joint set enter as actual sources. URDF conversion produces an MJCF candidate that must be checked for unsupported actuators, frame changes, collision approximations and physical parameters.
recipes.summary: Explicit robot joints plus CAD geometry become a robot structure, collision and mass-property assets, URDF, and MJCF conversion.

recipes.name: CAD robot, Menagerie kinematics and scanned environment to MJCF
recipes.goal: Use a real Menagerie MJCF model as a kinematic starting point, map CAD geometry to its bodies, and add scan-derived environment collision geometry.
handoffs: Seed MJCF must be an identified Menagerie model recorded through DOM-06 with its per-model licence. Mapping the sourced CAD component to MJCF body names and replacing visuals are explicit human-reviewed mappings; scanned surfaces become approximate collision meshes.
recipes.summary: A selected Menagerie MJCF supplies real kinematics; CAD geometry is mapped to its bodies; capture data supplies an environment mesh and collision set for an MJCF scene.

recipes.name: Sketch overlay on existing CAD model to controlled revision
recipes.goal: Compare a sketch overlay with an existing CAD model and create an explicitly reviewed geometric revision.
handoffs: Existing CAD solid remains the starting model; do not overwrite. The resulting profile/solid is a proposed revision and STEP is an exchange derivative with recorded fidelity.
recipes.summary: Calibrate sketch and drawing evidence, author a revision from a brief/profile, inspect it against the prior model, and export a separate exchange file.

recipes.name: Photo set to measured, reusable component
recipes.goal: Build a traceable parametric component from a photo set and measurements, then register and export it for reuse.
handoffs: Photogrammetry mesh is reference evidence; measurements constrain CAD dimensions. Keep reconstructed mesh and parametric CAD as separate linked assets. Component licensing applies to source model/assets individually.
recipes.summary: Intake source rights, reconstruct a mesh reference, remodel measured geometry parametrically and create a versioned reusable component record.

recipes.name: BIM library component to semantic IFC, display scene and static MuJoCo environment
recipes.goal: Place a licensed BIM component in a semantic IFC building, generate display geometry and a static simulation world.
handoffs: IFC remains semantic source. Triangle mesh and collider are derivatives; a static MuJoCo world contains no articulated robot. Preserve library/source licensing on the component record.
recipes.summary: A licensed BIM part is placed in a semantic IFC project; IFC geometry is converted to display mesh and collision representation for a static MuJoCo environment.

recipes.name: Scanned environment to collision geometry in an existing robot MJCF
recipes.goal: Add a scan-derived collider to an existing MJCF scene while retaining the source point cloud and explicit approximation record.
handoffs: The robot MJCF is an actual seed. Point-cloud triangulation and convex decomposition alter surface geometry; preserve originals, component frames and algorithm/version/settings.
recipes.summary: Convert registered scan points to a mesh, generate an explicit collision approximation and add it to an existing MJCF scene.

ideas.name: One canonical component schema with domain adapters
ideas.summary: Store identity, source/license, geometry representations, units/frames and physical values once; generate IFC, URDF, MJCF and visual exports through explicit adapters.
ideas.next_check: Prototype one mechanical component and one IFC product; document representation loss in each export.

ideas.name: Assembly to URDF workflow
ideas.summary: Use explicit joints and interface frames from CAD assembly as robot-description inputs; keep automated joint inference as a reviewable suggestion.
ideas.next_check: Compare FreeCAD assembly joint records to a URDF fixture and inspect one STEP-inference converter without treating its output as verified.

ideas.name: Open-chain and closed-chain robot models
ideas.summary: Use URDF for link/joint tree consumers; investigate MJCF native constraints or a multibody formulation for closed loops and parallel mechanisms.
ideas.next_check: Find current primary documentation for closed-chain mechanisms in the chosen robot simulator and define a loop-conversion fixture.

ideas.name: CAD solid to visual/collision/inertial triple
ideas.summary: Every robot link has separately authored high-detail visual geometry, simplified collision pieces and sourced mass/inertia attached to explicit frames.
ideas.next_check: Build a link with a non-convex opening and compare mesh collision, convex decomposition and primitive fit.

ideas.name: Plan plus scan to IFC as-built model
ideas.summary: Use measured scan alignment as surface evidence, plan interpretation for semantic element boundaries and IFC relationships for the building model.
ideas.next_check: Define registration-control/held-out-control split and document how uncertain wall/opening boundaries enter IFC.

ideas.name: CAD/STEP/B-rep fidelity gates
ideas.summary: Use STEP for geometry exchange while comparing the actual exporter/importer pair; source formats differ in whether they preserve analytic faces, assemblies and parametric history.
ideas.next_check: Use a cylinder, hole and two-part assembly fixture; report face types, names, bounds, volume and lost feature history.

ideas.name: IFC parametric element versus mesh representation
ideas.summary: Use parametric profiles/sweeps for elements where editability and quantities matter; use IFC mesh representations for complex as-built/furniture shapes and keep classification/property mapping explicit.
ideas.next_check: Export profile-extrusion and mesh forms of one element and compare import fidelity and IDS/property retention.

ideas.name: Scan to CAD with evidence labels
ideas.summary: Maintain scan, controls, fitted primitive/features, independent residuals and CAD source as separate linked representations.
ideas.next_check: Test one manufactured mechanical component with held-out interface dimensions.

ideas.name: Menagerie robot model reuse
ideas.summary: Reuse licensed MJCF structures and collision/visual examples as simulator fixtures or references, while checking each model's license and model-specific fidelity statement.
ideas.next_check: Select a model whose license permits the intended use and inspect its README, assets and revision before intake.

ideas.name: Rights-aware reusable asset catalog
ideas.summary: Store vendor CAD and community models with item-level rights and immutable source hashes; separate asset licenses from tool licenses and project license.
ideas.next_check: Create an intake record for one CC-BY component and one restricted manufacturer STEP download.

ideas.name: Poly Haven visual environment library
ideas.summary: Use CC0 assets and HDRIs to construct architectural and product rendering contexts; do not use asset dimensions as component specifications.
ideas.next_check: Assess asset metadata, scale indicators and dependency size for a visual scene fixture.

ideas.name: Blender scripting and MCP orchestration
ideas.summary: Keep OCS as engineering baseline; use deterministic Blender background scripts for repeatable conversion and checks, with MCP live inspection as a later interactive layer.
ideas.next_check: Compare scripted and MCP scene edits once the local Blender 5.0.1 compatibility constraint is resolved or a compatible integration chosen.

ideas.name: Menagerie robot plus scan environment simulation
ideas.summary: Combine an articulated robot description with a registered room or terrain mesh, then derive a simplified collision scene while keeping source coordinates and body frames linked.
ideas.next_check: Create a miniature scene with one articulated robot and one scanned obstacle; verify frame transforms and collision envelope.

ideas.name: Sketch-over-model revision workflow
ideas.summary: Align new sketch/image dimensions to an existing model datum, revise its native source, and regenerate geometry and visual exports without losing unrelated component identity.
ideas.next_check: Exercise a changed hole position against a pinned source model and compare a before/after measurement manifest.

ideas.name: Engineering asset quality classes
ideas.summary: Distinguish visual-only assets, approximate component geometry, dimensioned supplier CAD, measured parts and verified simulation models with explicit source evidence.
ideas.next_check: Define permitted downstream operations for each asset evidence class without presenting a license or visual source as engineering validation.
